schema_version: v0 — component-charter shape; migrates into the intention envelope when MAP.md Q6 lands
what: The instrument that answers ONE question per component, mechanically: if you ran this again, would you get the same answer? It walks each component's shipped import closure (composing cairn.tools.import_sieve's reach walk and band ladder — never re-deriving them) and returns a verdict: DETERMINISTIC (reaches no oracle and shells out to nothing), MOSTLY DETERMINISTIC (no oracle, but shells out — `git` over a committed tree, or a proof subprocess), or REACHES AN ORACLE (the closure arrives at inference, 5432, the trees, or the network). The roster is DISK — every directory holding an intention+why.json that ships code — so nothing declares itself onto the report and nothing falls off it except by ceasing to exist. THE FIRE PATH AND THE LEARNING SEAM ARE WALKED SEPARATELY: a component's nexus.py is a question-nexus, where reaching an oracle is the design, so its reach is REPORTED but never counted against the verdict. `measure(root)` returns the report; `render(report)` is the surface; `python3 -m cairn.tools.determinism.determinism [--json]` is the door. It judges nothing about whether a component OUGHT to be deterministic — it measures what is, and the disposition is Akien's.
why: Akien, 2026-08-13, verbatim: 'we're sprinting toward akien can inspect the gates and inspectors and find them deterministic and mostly deterministic respectively. I want to SEE that before anything else. That's our base level thing above skills. but it has to be the thing those skills can depend on. I have to SEE that with my own eyes before we move on to anything else.' THE LIVED SYMPTOM: he cannot look at the layer his skills stand on and tell whether it holds. build_inspector's charter has asserted since 2026-07-27 that a gate is 'inference-free by construction ... a gate that consults an oracle is not a gate' and that its verdict is 'always HARDWARE' — a claim about a FIRE PATH that was readable, plausible, and unfalsifiable at a glance for seventeen days. Law 3: nothing is known until measured, and an unmeasured claim is a hypothesis. Law 9: green is earned, and prose asserting green is not an earning. This walks the path so the claim can be wrong.
invoke: `cairn determinism` — the whole report, most-replayable first; `cairn determinism --json` for the machine-readable one; `cairn determinism <root>` to walk a tree other than this repo. import: `from cairn.tools.determinism import determinism`. Prove: `python3 cairn/tools/determinism/proofs/test_determinism.py`.
node_class: tool — a complete primitive with USERS, not an owner (Law 6, ruling 2026-08-13-tools-have-users-not-owners). It holds no state: it reads the tree and returns a report, keeping nothing between calls, so there is nothing for an owner to gate. No runtime state, no daemon; fires when someone asks.
entry: FRESH build, 2026-08-13, composing import_sieve. Deliberate reuse on the record: the reach walk (`reaches`), the off-box ladder (`DEFAULT_LADDER[3]`) and the mention-vs-capability mesh all belong to import_sieve and are imported, not copied (Law 1, I-borrow-patterns-cite-dont-graft). Re-deriving reach here would re-earn the two failures import_sieve's header records — a docstring's honest mention of inference_domain firing a grep, and a port number in an error string doing the same.
state_and_history: compiled to state.json (projected window) + history.json (append-only voyage) beside this charter.
how_it_learns: FROM THE GAP BETWEEN ITS VERDICT AND AKIEN'S. It emits a verdict per component and judges no component wrong; a disagreement is therefore always visible as his correction rather than as a silent pass. Its first two learnings both arrived on its first run and are built in: (1) it collapsed the fire path into the learning seam and reported build_inspector — THE gate — as reaching an oracle, when the reach was nexus.py, which that charter has always kept out of fire-time; the split is now physics (LEARNING_SEAM). (2) it named a column GATES when what it measures is a declared refusal class, which build_inspector's fire path does not have at all — the column is now REFUSES, narrowed to what was measured. THE STANDING EDGE: gate-ness itself is not derived here. No charter field declares 'I am a gate', so this instrument cannot red a gate for reaching an oracle — it can only show the reach and let a reader judge. That is the next rung, and it is filed rather than faked.
filed_edges: (a) A GATE DECLARES ITSELF. Today gate-ness lives in prose (one charter says 'device (gate)', and it is stale — build_inspector berths as a machine since the rung move). Until a charter declares it in a field, this tool reports reach and cannot red a gate that consults an oracle — which is the check Akien actually wants. Ticket owed.

(b) THE SEVEN BUILDER MACHINES REACH AN ORACLE (constrain, decompose, hypothesize, orient, survey, triage, validate — each via tools/tree/tree.py -> librarian -> db_domain -> psycopg2). Measured 2026-08-13, undispositioned: legitimate if they are pipeline stages whose questions live in the trees, a defect if any is a gate. Needs (a) to answer mechanically.

(c) `learning/` SITS ON NO RUNG. Found by this tool's own first run: a component with a charter and code at the repo root, born 2026-07-17, missed by the big-bang reorg — it reports rung '?'. Not moved here; a berth move is its own crossing.

(d) A SHELLED BINARY IS JUDGED BY REPUTATION. `git` is called replayable because it is git, which is a claim about git, not a measurement of it. A subprocess that dials is invisible — inherited whole from import_sieve and deliberately not weakened.

(e) NO SECOND CONSUMER YET. The report is read by Akien and by this component's proofs. It is not wired into the emit chokepoint and does not gate anything, so it is an instrument, not yet a gate — and the record does not dress it as one.
gates: proof gate — proofs/test_determinism.py under the tester. Durability gate: committed + pushed.
falsifier: RED on any of: (1) a component whose closure provably reaches an oracle is reported DETERMINISTIC; (2) a component that reaches nothing off-box is reported as reaching one (a report that reds everything gets ignored, which is the failure mode of a scan nobody trusts); (3) the roster misses a component that holds a charter and ships code, or invents one that does not exist; (4) a learning seam's oracle reach is counted against the fire-path verdict, or is silently dropped instead of reported; (5) it returns a clean-looking report over a tree it never read (the hollow floor — Law 8). WRONG-SHAPE SIGNAL: if the verdict stops changing when components genuinely move, the roster has quietly become a list.
proof: proofs/test_determinism.py — the three verdicts pinned on synthetic components with known reach; the hollow floor refusing an unread tree; the fire-path/learning-seam split pinned by a fixture whose only oracle reach is through nexus.py; the roster derived from disk on the real tree by invariant, never by snapshot count.
owner: A TOOL HAS USERS, NOT AN OWNER (Law 6). It holds no state, so there is nothing to gate. CC writes the code and proofs; Akien owns the design — the definition of the three verdicts and the disposition of what the report shows.
traces_to: Law 3 (nothing is known until measured — this converts a seventeen-day-old prose claim into a walk)
Law 9 (red is the default, green is earned — an assertion of inference-freedom is not an earning)
Law 4 (a rule enforced by physics; today this is the measurement, and edge (a) is the honest IOU for the enforcement)
Law 1 (the reach walk lives once, in import_sieve)
I-nexi-everywhere (fire paths are hardware; the learning seam is where the oracle belongs)
provenance: Born 2026-08-13, hours after the rung move, in answer to Akien's sprint: 'I have to SEE that with my own eyes before we move on to anything else.' Its first run reported build_inspector — the corpus's own post-build gate — as reaching an oracle, which was true of the component and false about the gate; the third instrument in this system whose first act was to catch something about its own family.
